gaps.sentence: If I ___ you, I'd apologise immediately.
gaps.explanation: 'If I were you' — subjunctive 'were' for unreal situations.

gaps.sentence: She went to university ___ study law.
Unless it ___ , the match will go ahead.
gaps.explanation: 'unless' = if…not; present simple after time/condition words.

gaps.sentence: The cat cleans ___ after every meal.
gaps.explanation: Reflexive: the cat cleans ITSELF (the object is the same as the subject).

gaps.sentence: This time tomorrow we ___ flying to Rome.
gaps.explanation: Future continuous: will be + -ing for an action in progress at a future time.

gaps.sentence: He ___ his keys on the bus this morning.
gaps.explanation: 'leave something somewhere' = forget to take it: left his keys on the bus.
